docs.title: Welcome to My blog
docs.text: I created this blog to share my thoughts, learnings, and experiences with you.

docs.title: What do you want to explore today?
docs.text:
Here are the topics I plan to write about:

  • Chess

Quick hits on tactics, patterns, and ideas. No theory dumps—just what sticks and wins games.

You can find my chess.com page here.

  • Verification

Notes on many things related to Design Verification and relevant gotchas.

  • Philosophy

Snippets of old-school wisdom. Nothing preachy—just thoughts worth chewing on.

I hope you find this blog interesting and informative. Cheers!

Side Note: The picture I used on this page, is a caveman sharing his learnings. It is supposed to metaphorically represent me sharing my understandings through this blog!
